questions.question: Who is currently third from bottom of the Premier League table today, Saturday, 28th November 2026?
questions.clue: Known as "The Black Cats," this Wearside club plays its home matches at the Stadium of Light.
questions.funFact: They sit 18th in the table on 8 points, occupying the final relegation spot ahead of Manchester United and Crystal Palace.

questions.question: Nottingham Forest played and won last night in the Friday night match; who did they beat?
questions.clue: A West London club that plays its home matches at Stamford Bridge.
questions.funFact: Forest claimed a massive three points under the Friday night floodlights against the West London visitors.

questions.question: What was the score in that match?
questions.clue: A narrow one-goal victory for the hosts in which five goals were scored in total.
questions.funFact: Fans were treated to an end-to-end five-goal thriller on Friday night.

questions.question: Which Nottingham Forest player scored twice last night (Friday)?
questions.clue: An English attacking midfielder who wears the number 10 shirt at the City Ground.
questions.funFact: The creative midfielder spearheaded Forest's attack with a decisive brace to sink the Blues.

questions.question: On this day in football history, 28th November 1862, which Midlands professional football club was formed, making it the world's oldest?
questions.clue: Nicknamed "The Magpies," they play across the River Trent from local rivals Nottingham Forest.
questions.funFact: Formed in 1862, they were one of the 12 founding members of the Football League in 1888 and famously inspired Juventus's iconic black-and-white striped kits.

questions.question: Which country is Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Xavi Simons from?
questions.clue: He represents the European footballing nation famously known as "Oranje."
questions.funFact: Named after Barcelona legend Xavi Hernández, he developed in the youth academies of Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain before starring at the international level.

questions.question: What squad number does Jordan Pickford wear for Everton?
questions.clue: The traditional single-digit number worn by a team's first-choice goalkeeper.
questions.funFact: He has worn Everton's primary goalkeeping jersey ever since arriving from Sunderland in 2017.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has Pep Guardiola won?
questions.clue: An even single-digit number equal to three multiplied by two.
questions.funFact: He made English football history in 2023–24 by guiding Manchester City to an unprecedented fourth consecutive Premier League crown.

questions.question: Who is Arsenal's top scorer (in all competitions) so far this season?
questions.clue: The Norwegian playmaker who wears the captain's armband at the Emirates Stadium.
questions.funFact: The inspirational skipper leads the Gunners' scoring charts across domestic and European competitions this season.

questions.question: What is the seating capacity of Arsenal's Emirates Stadium?
questions.clue: A five-digit number sitting exactly 10,000 above 50,704 and 10,000 below 70,704.
questions.funFact: Opened in July 2006 in Holloway, North London, it replaced Arsenal's historic former home at Highbury.
